result:
I’d make misinformation and disinformation much harder to spread—by default.

Specifically: every major piece of information (news, viral posts, political claims, health advice) would come with a reliable, easy-to-understand provenance and verification layer: where it came from, how trustworthy it is, and whether independent experts have validated it. People wouldn’t need to be experts to make safer choices—they’d get clear signals automatically.

The goal wouldn’t be censorship; it’d be accountability and transparency, so truth can travel faster than manipulation.
